mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 200k & UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% year-over-year signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic growth, which is a positive indicator for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ > 2%.
